    // The chord leaving knot i (p_i+1 - p_i).
    TcbForwardChord(self: TcbSpline3D, i: Integer): Vector3D
        => self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
               .Between(self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed));

    // The departing tangent at knot i.
    TcbOutgoingTangent(self: TcbSpline3D, i: Integer): Vector3D
        => self.TcbBackChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbOutgoingBackWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                          self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed))
         + self.TcbForwardChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbOutgoingForwardWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                             self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed));

    // The arriving tangent at knot i.
    TcbIncomingTangent(self: TcbSpline3D, i: Integer): Vector3D
        => self.TcbBackChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbIncomingBackWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                          self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed))
         + self.TcbForwardChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbIncomingForwardWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                             self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed));

    // The point on a TCB spline at t: the Hermite segment between the bracketing
    // knots, with the departing tangent of the first and the arriving tangent
    // of the second.
    Eval(self: TcbSpline2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => self.Points.AtWrapped(self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t), self.Closed)
               .PositionVector
               .Hermite(self.Points
                            .AtWrapped(self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t) + 1,
                                       self.Closed)
                            .PositionVector,
                        self.TcbOutgoingTangent(
                            self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t)),
                        self.TcbIncomingTangent(
                            self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t) + 1),
                        self.Points.Count.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t))
               .ToPoint;

    // The point on a TCB spline at t.
    Eval(self: TcbSpline3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Points.AtWrapped(self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t), self.Closed)
               .PositionVector
               .Hermite(self.Points
                            .AtWrapped(self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t) + 1,
                                       self.Closed)
                            .PositionVector,
                        self.TcbOutgoingTangent(
                            self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t)),
                        self.TcbIncomingTangent(
                            self.Points.Count.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t) + 1),
                        self.Points.Count.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t))
               .ToPoint;

    //==
    // # Piecewise-linear splines

    // The point on a piecewise-linear spline at t: a straight lerp within the
    // span bracketing t.
    Eval(self: LinearSpline2D, t: Number): Point2D
    {
        var n = self.Points.Count;
        var i = n.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t);
        return self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
            .Lerp(self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed),
                  n.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t));
    }

    // The point on a piecewise-linear spline at t.
    Eval(self: LinearSpline3D, t: Number): Point3D
    {
        var n = self.Points.Count;
        var i = n.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t);
        return self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
            .Lerp(self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed),
                  n.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t));
    }

    //==
    // # Natural cubic spline
    //
    // TODO(interface-gap): a natural cubic spline's second derivatives come from
    // a tridiagonal solve over all knots (the Thomas algorithm). `Reduce` now
    // exists, but Thomas is a two-pass sweep: a forward elimination that builds
    // modified super-diagonal and right-hand-side ARRAYS (each entry reading the
    // one before it), then a backward substitution over those arrays. Expressed
    // with fold that is a `Reduce` carrying a tuple-of-arrays accumulator plus a
    // second reverse pass — correct but not clean — so NaturalCubicSpline1D
    // keeps no Eval. The accessors below at least give its parallel arrays a
    // reader.

    // The number of knots. Parameters and Values have equal counts.
    KnotCount(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D): Integer
        => self.Parameters.Count;

    // The parameter of the knot at the given position.
    KnotParameter(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, index: Integer): Number
        => self.Parameters[index];

    // The value of the knot at the given position.
    KnotValue(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, index: Integer): Number
        => self.Values[index];

    // The parameter range the spline interpolates over.
    ParameterDomain(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D): NumberInterval
        => (self.KnotParameter(0), self.KnotParameter(self.KnotCount - 1));

    //==
    // # NaturalCubicSpline1D — evaluation
    //
    // The C2 interpolant: on each span the cubic determined by the two endpoint
    // values and the two endpoint SECOND derivatives, the latter fixed by
    // requiring a continuous first derivative across every interior knot — a
    // tridiagonal system closed by the natural condition (zero curvature at the
    // ends). Solved by the Thomas algorithm, written as recursions because a
    // sweep carrying an array across iterations has no spelling here; each
    // recursion recomputes its predecessors, so evaluation is polynomial rather
    // than linear in the sample count. Correct, not fast (plato-321).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spline_interpolation

    // The width of span i, from knot i to knot i + 1.
    SpanWidth(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, i: Integer): Number
        => self.KnotParameter(i + 1) - self.KnotParameter(i);

    // The slope of the chord across span i.
    SpanSlope(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, i: Integer): Number
        => (self.KnotValue(i + 1) - self.KnotValue(i)) / self.SpanWidth(i);

    // The sub-diagonal coefficient of interior equation j.
    SweepBelow(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => self.SpanWidth(j - 1);

    // The diagonal coefficient of interior equation j.
    SweepDiagonal(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => 2.0 * (self.SpanWidth(j - 1) + self.SpanWidth(j));

    // The super-diagonal coefficient of interior equation j.
    SweepAbove(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => self.SpanWidth(j);

    // The right-hand side of interior equation j: six times the change in chord
    // slope across knot j, which is what the second derivative must absorb.
    SweepRight(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => 6.0 * (self.SpanSlope(j) - self.SpanSlope(j - 1));

    // The pivot of equation j after elimination against equation j - 1.
    SweepPivot(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => j <= 1
            ? self.SweepDiagonal(1)
            : self.SweepDiagonal(j) - self.SweepBelow(j) * self.SweepRatio(j - 1);

    // The eliminated super-diagonal coefficient of equation j.
    SweepRatio(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => self.SweepAbove(j) / self.SweepPivot(j);
